title: WhoDunnitAI — The Voice-Driven Murder Mystery
excerpt: Step into the interrogation room. Interview AI suspects with your own voice, catch their lies, and accuse the killer to their face. Solve the murder at Blackwood Manor — if you can.
content_html:
Case File No. 001

Death at Blackwood Manor

A poisoned patriarch. Five guests. One locked-in truth.

Watch the demo

Evidence Reel

Watch Chase demo the case

Interviewing suspects, pressing them on their alibis, and catching the contradictions.

Keep the Manor Open

WhoDunnitAI is free to play, but the live suspect voices run on gpt-realtime-2 — and every minute of interrogation costs real money. If you enjoyed the case, a donation of any size helps cover the AI bill and keeps the investigation going.
